stemMarkdown: Find the area (in square cm) of a sector of a circle of radius 14 cm subtending an angle of $60$ degrees at the centre. Use $\pi = 3.14159265$. (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: A sector is the fraction $\dfrac{60}{360}$ of the whole circle: $\dfrac{60}{360} \times \pi \times 14^2 = 102.6254$ square cm.
